description: stock mode keeps the editor's host repositories, without the exe.dev account. Project {{NAME}} exists. The test mocks the server's exe.dev endpoints: the host's repositories are acme/host; call "account-reads" counts the page's reads of the GitHub accounts and of the project's exe.dev account; call "changes" returns the account changes the editor asked for. "The editor" is {"role": "region", "name": "Edit project", "exact": true}, the element section[aria-label='Edit project']; things "in the editor" are scoped to it (a selector after "section[aria-label='Edit project'] ", or {"within": {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']"}, ...} for a role). To "open the editor of P": click "section[aria-label='P'] a.project-select", then click {"within": {"selector": "[data-testid='project-view']", "role": "navigation"}, "role": "button", "name": "Settings", "exact": true}. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Click the button "Open conversations", then the button "View options", then {"selector": ".group-by-menu-item", "has_text": "Project", "exact": true}. 3. Open the editor of {{NAME}}. 4. There is no "section[aria-label='Edit project'] [data-testid='project-integrations']" (assert_count 0). 7. Call "account-reads" with expect "0". 8. Call "changes" with expect "[]".
